changes: Stage 3: rule-based main server (main_controller.py) — weighted 4-corner fit with outlier rejection, 5 priority cases with the reach stacker's own sensor, disagreement handling, lowering interlock

Virtual site (reachstacker_sim.py, sim_site.py, sim_bridge.py): approach, correction moves, lower/lock/raise, machine-sensor modes, kit corner faults; built-in and example server give identical results; UI shows server decisions
Comparison experiment (tools/compare_strategies.py) and optional local AI operator via Ollama with whitelisted commands (tools/ai_operator.py)
Stage 1: kit as field device — 7 commands (start_job/sense/resense/end_job/stop/fault_reset/self_test), 4 units x 23 items (bundle v2), FAULT/SELF_TEST states, watchdog, heartbeat
Python port of the v3.5.4 engine (maskit_engine.py) identical to JS trial by trial; per-unit device logic (kit_device.py); server-side history estimation + rigid fit (maskit_server_logic.py)
Kit link: main server directs each sensing (start_job / sense / end_job / stop); kit senses once per command
One 4-unit bundle per sensing stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\MASKIT\Link\outbox.sqlite3, then sent in order (store-and-forward, retry)
Kit states IDLE/SENSING/WAITING persisted across restart; server commands delivered in upload replies
Built-in LocalMainSim when no server_url (simulation only)
Simulator UI: one run = one job following the machine sequence; Monte Carlo batches are not sent
Example main server (server_example/maskit_main_server.py) with auto/manual modes
Simulator math, casebank DB schema and data location unchanged
